questions.question: Ti hol tartjátok a ___ ?
questions.answer: kulcsotokat - Where do you (plural) keep your keys?
questions.translate: Where do you (plural) keep your keys?

questions.question: Az ő ___ nagyon barátságosak.
questions.answer: macskáik - Their cats are very friendly

questions.question: Láttam a ___ telefonját az asztalon.
questions.answer: fiú - I saw the boy's phone on the table
questions.translate: I saw the boy's phone on the table

questions.question: Ez nem az én kabátom, hanem az ő ___ .
questions.answer: kabátja - This isn’t my coat, it’s his/hers
questions.translate: This isn’t my coat, it’s his/hers

questions.question: A barátaim autója új, de a ___ régi.
questions.answer: miénk - My friends' car is new, but ours is old
questions.translate: My friends' car is new, but ours is old

questions.question: Ez nem az én ___ , hanem az övé.
questions.answer: székem - This is not my chair, it's his/hers
questions.translate: This is not my chair, it's his/hers
